title: Marty NoPixel 5.0 — Day 1
summary: Marty (Marty Banks) launches into NoPixel 5.0 with the Brick Boys: Lang Buddha, Jean Paul, Marty Banks, and Tony Corleone.

1.title: Day 1 — Server Launch & Brick Boys Assembly
1.summary: Day 1 of NoPixel 5.0 for Marty Banks. The Brick Boys assemble as a 4-man unit, face Mr. Cement, split into 2-man grinding duos, and execute a canal police getaway.

storyArcs.title: The Brick Boys Reunited & Mr. Cement Challenge
storyArcs.description: The veteran quartet arrives in Los Santos 5.0, assembles their crew, and travels to the desert ranch for Mr. Cement initiation challenge.

storyArcs.title: 2-Man Hustles: Crime vs Business
storyArcs.description: The Brick Boys divide and conquer: X and Marty hit the streets for ATM cracking and rooftop drops, while Buddha and Tony set up the Guber taxi business front.

storyArcs.title: High-Speed Escapes & Police Clashes
storyArcs.description: Intense chases through the city alleys and LS Storm Drain canals with Tony behind the wheel executing legendary drift evasions.

storyArcs.title: The Octane Crypto Scheme & Financial Pooling
storyArcs.description: Pooling crew profits at Burger Shot and buying into the volatile Octane coin surge on the in-game phone exchange.

storyArcs.title: The Brick Boys Syndicate Founded
storyArcs.description: Securing an industrial safehouse, stashing stolen blueprints, and swearing the Brick Boys syndicate oath.

events.title: Marty Banks Wakes Up in Los Santos 5.0
events.description: Marty Banks wakes up at the launch of NoPixel 5.0, exploring the new city atmosphere, checking initial inventory, and opening the in-game phone to radio the crew.
events.arcTitle: The Brick Boys Reunited & Mr. Cement Challenge

events.title: The Brick Boys Syndicate Assembles
events.description: Lang Buddha, Tony Corleone, Jean Paul (X), and Marty Banks meet outside the starter hub. The veteran quartet reunites to form the Brick Boys syndicate for 5.0.
events.arcTitle: The Brick Boys Reunited & Mr. Cement Challenge

events.title: 4-Man Convoy Ride to Senora Desert
events.description: Tony Corleone takes the wheel of the lead cruiser with Lang Buddha riding shotgun, while Jean Paul and Marty follow closely in convoy as the crew heads toward the Grand Senora Desert.
events.arcTitle: The Brick Boys Reunited & Mr. Cement Challenge

events.title: The Mr. Cement Ranch Initiation Challenge
events.description: The Brick Boys arrive at the desert ranch to meet Mr. Cement. The eccentric leader tests the quartet with a high-stakes endurance challenge before offering his syndicate blessing.
events.arcTitle: The Brick Boys Reunited & Mr. Cement Challenge

events.title: Dividing into 2-Man Grinding Duos
events.description: The Brick Boys strategize their initial empire growth: X and Marty pair up for criminal reconnaissance and ATM cracking, while Buddha and Tony depart to build the Guber taxi legal front.

events.title: 2-Man Duo: X & Marty Hit ATM Reconnaissance
events.description: Jean Paul and Marty Banks scale rooftops in South Los Santos, scouting ATM security cameras and testing physical lockboxes to prepare for their first city heist.

events.title: Police Pursuit: X & Marty Evade Officer Andrews
events.description: Officer Andrews spots X and Marty fleeing an alleyway rooftop. X drives aggressively down tight backstreets and successfully loses police line of sight.

events.title: Burger Shot Meeting & Profit Pooling
events.description: The full 4-man Brick Boys crew regroups inside Burger Shot. Over burgers and banter with Robert Spumoni, X and Marty pool their ATM proceeds with Buddha and Tony.
events.arcTitle: The Octane Crypto Scheme & Financial Pooling

events.title: The Octane Crypto Surge & Syndicate Buy-In
events.description: Marty notices a major breakout on the Octane Coin phone exchange. Jean Paul convinces the quartet to invest pooled syndicate capital before the next price spike.
events.arcTitle: The Octane Crypto Scheme & Financial Pooling

events.title: Full Crew Canal Police Pursuit: Tony Drift Escape
events.description: All four Brick Boys are traveling together when multiple police cruisers initiate a high-speed stop. Tony takes the wheel, executing a breathtaking drift into the LS Storm Drains and escaping clean.

events.title: Industrial Safehouse Debrief & Syndicate Oath
events.description: The Brick Boys reach an abandoned industrial warehouse to stash their tools and cash. Buddha, X, Marty, and Tony swear the Brick Boys oath and outline their Day 2 takeover plans.
